summary: 32 units reviewed; 13 errors, 27 minor; 19 units need fixes. No regrouping suggested. Main problems: bracketed glosses in Hindi (units 5,9,10,13,14,15,27); imported commentary in glosses (verse-type, head-ornament, garment, harmful; units 7,8,25); unit 5 split gupito wrongly normalised to guptaḥ; unit 10 Hindi mis-parse of 'the sky was the covering'; unit 27 added though/because. Remaining doubts: 6/7/8/9/11/19/22/27-29 are inherently uncertain (confidence already low/medium); kva'deṣṭrāya avagraha (unit 14); 3 reading of manyate; vareyam, yātyā, svastakau, addhātayaḥ, saha-saṃbhalāyai unresolved.
